name: stop-sound
description: Chimes when Claude waits for you: when it finishes a turn and when it asks a question. Silent while subagents work.

stop_sound.title: Stop sound
stop_sound.description: Sound file (wav, mp3, aiff, m4a, ogg) played when the session ends its turn. Leave empty for the bundled chime.

question_sound.title: Question sound
question_sound.description: Sound file (wav, mp3, aiff, m4a, ogg) played when Claude asks a question or presents a plan. Leave empty for the bundled chime.
